extras: Requires Better Export PDF to generate TLP badges in exported PDFs.
intentEvidence: Classify your Obsidian documents using the Traffic Light Protocol (TLP) standard.
problem: Users need a standardized way to classify document sensitivity using the Traffic Light Protocol (TLP) and display this classification during PDF export.

relations.evidence: automatic PDF header/footer badge generation for Better Export PDF.

summary: A plugin that classifies Obsidian documents using the Traffic Light Protocol (TLP) standard, providing visual selectors and automatic PDF badge generation.
